goal: Turn NestClaw into a local-first LLM job control plane while preserving cloud/API provider optionality

items.title: Define Agent Profile spec
items.goal: Define local/cloud provider agent profiles with allowed jobs, capability packs, execution budgets, sensitivity boundaries, and approval policy

items.title: Define Job Template spec
items.goal: Define repeatable job templates with input schema, capability pack binding, provider policy, schedule trigger, and output evidence

items.title: Bind capability packs to jobs and profiles
items.goal: Define curated capability packs and connect them to allowed tools, approval requirements, job templates, and agent profiles

items.title: Run local LLM job invocation PoC
items.goal: Run one constrained local LLM job through existing CLI/MCP/HTTP surfaces and capture status, events, report, and audit evidence
